title: apiKeyEnvVar returns a value for the same four providers and is the fallback source of the key
source_evidence: DroppyCode/Core/Models/Provider.swift:126-135 apiKeyEnvVar - DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, MODEL_API_KEY, ZAI_API_KEY, COMMAND_CODE_API_KEY; default nil
DroppyCode/App/AppSettings.swift:905-906 apiKey(for:) - when nothing is stored, the env var is read from the login environment and trimmed
preconditions: No key is stored in Settings for the provider.
action: apiKey(for:) is called.
expected_result: The named environment variable is read from the captured login environment, trimmed of whitespace and newlines, and returned. A provider with a nil apiKeyEnvVar, or one where acceptsAPIKey is false, returns the empty string without reading anything.
side_effects: Reads the captured environment; no process launch.
failure_cases: Variable absent: the empty string is returned and the provider reads as signed out.
windows_path: Read from the process environment plus the user and machine registry Environment keys, since Windows has no login-shell capture. Platform boundary: environment capture.
